EditorMetadata.Comment: Regression gate for the AiPrimitive-Params sizing bug: composes a REAL editor-authored/generated blueprint (EnumDemo, BlueprintId 0x235986DF, produced by the Blueprints source generator in the SAME compilation as this BTree asset) as a host-BTree node, instead of the hand-written DemoAiPrimitiveNodes stand-in used by T31. Before the fix, the BTree generator's Roslyn-only StructSizeResolver could never see EnumDemo_235986DF_Bp+Params (sibling generators are blind to each other's output), so the asset was skipped with BTREE0002 and the editor's in-memory path fell back to an uncompilable method-group .Action(TickCore, ...) bind. The fix resolves Params' size from EnumDemo.bp.json's parameter schema at generation time instead of reflecting the not-yet-built type.

Variables.Name: bpParams
Variables.Comment: Authored params for the composed EnumDemo blueprint. EnumDemo currently declares zero AiPrimitive Parameters, so this Params struct has no fields (size resolved from EnumDemo.bp.json's empty Parameters array).
